settings.label: Contact
settings.heading: Say hello.
settings.subtext: Whether you have a question about an order, want to discuss a custom piece, or just want to tell us how a Drifter looks in your nursery — we’d love to hear from you.

settings.label: Get in Touch
settings.heading: We’d love to hear from you.
settings.body: We respond to every message personally, usually within a day or two. For order-related questions, include your order number and we’ll get back to you faster.
